geometry.coordinateConvention: SI; nose +X; zero-incidence velocity -X; source s=totalLength-X
geometry.dimensionRule: 1.80in diameter, 3.33in cone, 8.00in cylinder, 6.24in flare; exact 10deg flare
geometry.baseBoundaryAssumption: closed flat base; tunnel sting/support not represented; no base validation

condition.staticStateMethod: ideal gas gamma1.4 total-to-static; density inferred using Sutherland and unit Reynolds
condition.pressureScope: equilibrium near-adiabatic; low-Re separation fairing is not independent measured points
condition.heatScope: transient nonuniform Tw; digitized paired temperature/heat data required

convergence.reason: 保存迭代已绑定且重启动EOS一致；残差通过与物理资格仍分别判断。

nativeCheckpointIdentity.reason: 最新完整原生具名文件对与当前壁面/体场逐字相同；本次运行局部迭代。
